description: Retrieves all external issue links for a Sentry issue. Returns connections between the Sentry issue and external tracking systems (e.g., Jira, GitHub Issues, Linear, GitLab, Asana) created through custom integrations or Sentry Apps. Use this to see what external tickets or issues are linked to a Sentry error.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving custom integration issue links for a given Sentry issue.

issue_id.description: The numeric ID of the Sentry issue to retrieve external issue links for. This is the numeric issue ID, not the short ID (e.g., use 7233953621, not 'PROJECT-123').
issue_id.title: Issue Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: RetrieveCustomIntegrationIssueLinksForTheGivenSentryIssueRequest

name: retrieve_custom_integ_issue_links_given_sentry_issue

ExternalIssueItem.description: Schema for a single external issue link.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name of the external issue
displayName.title: Display Name

id.description: Unique identifier of the external issue link
id.title: Id

issueId.description: ID of the Sentry issue (group) that this external issue is linked to
issueId.title: Issue Id

serviceType.description: Type of external service (e.g., jira, github, linear)
serviceType.title: Service Type

webUrl.description: URL of the external issue in the external service
webUrl.title: Web Url
